function layoutSnapshotCase(v) {
 document.body.innerHTML='<style id="rules">.box{width:40px;height:200px}</style>';
 document.body.style.cssText='margin:0';
 const checks={},host=document.createElement('main'),other=document.createElement('main'),box=document.createElement('div');
 host.style.cssText='position:relative;width:'+(150+v)+'px;height:80px;overflow:hidden';
 other.style.cssText='position:relative;width:'+(80+v)+'px;height:20px';
 box.className='box';document.body.append(host,other);host.append(box);
 const rect=e=>e.getBoundingClientRect(),equal=(a,b)=>Math.abs(a-b)<0.01;
 checks.initial=rect(box).width===40&&rect(box).height===200;
 checks.repeated=Array.from({length:20},()=>rect(box).width).every(width=>width===40);
 checks.metrics=box.offsetWidth===40&&box.clientWidth===40&&box.offsetHeight===200;
 checks.parent=box.offsetParent===host;
 checks.sibling=rect(other).y===80;
 checks.scrollExtent=host.scrollHeight===200&&host.clientHeight===80;
 host.scrollTop=20;checks.scroll=rect(box).y===-20&&host.scrollTop===20;
 checks.offsetIgnoresScroll=box.offsetTop===0;
 host.scrollTop=9999;checks.clamp=host.scrollTop===120&&rect(box).y===-120;
 host.scrollTop=0;checks.reset=rect(box).y===0;
 const sheet=document.getElementById('rules').sheet;
 sheet.cssRules[0].style.width='60px';checks.ruleStyle=rect(box).width===60;
 sheet.cssRules[0].selectorText='.other';checks.selector=rect(box).width===150+v;
 sheet.cssRules[0].selectorText='.box';checks.selectorRestore=rect(box).width===60;
 sheet.disabled=true;checks.disabled=rect(box).width===150+v;
 sheet.disabled=false;checks.enabled=rect(box).width===60;
 sheet.deleteRule(0);checks.deleteRule=rect(box).width===150+v;
 sheet.insertRule('.box{width:70px;height:200px}',0);checks.insertRule=rect(box).width===70;
 const adopted=new CSSStyleSheet();adopted.replaceSync('.box{width:75px}');document.adoptedStyleSheets=[adopted];
 checks.adopted=rect(box).width===75;document.adoptedStyleSheets=[];checks.unadopted=rect(box).width===70;
 box.removeAttribute('class');checks.attribute=rect(box).width===150+v;
 box.setAttribute('class','box');checks.attributeRestore=rect(box).width===70;
 box.style.width='90px';checks.inline=rect(box).width===90;
 box.style.removeProperty('width');checks.inlineRemoval=rect(box).width===70;
 host.style.width=(200+v)+'px';box.style.width='50%';checks.percentage=equal(rect(box).width,(200+v)/2);
 host.style.width=(220+v)+'px';checks.ancestor=equal(rect(box).width,(220+v)/2);
 other.append(box);checks.reparent=box.offsetParent===other&&rect(box).y===80&&equal(rect(box).width,(80+v)/2);
 box.remove();checks.detached=rect(box).width===0;host.append(box);checks.reattached=equal(rect(box).width,(220+v)/2);
 host.style.display='none';checks.hidden=rect(box).width===0;host.style.display='block';checks.recovered=equal(rect(box).width,(220+v)/2);
 return checks;
}
